purpose: Test the pure-height top endpoint on a constrained-axis-feasible input, not the historical disjoint off-axis dispatch fixture.
input_rule: Reuse the centered-axis shell and design meshes and their densities. Keep the x axis. Place the origin at the outer x minimum on the line through its geometric center. No output-dependent parameter selection.
discretization_reason: Reuse the existing centered-axis complete-method coarse normal discretization for this distinct objective integration diagnostic; not final geometric-precision or original-paper evidence.
preflight_role: The stored sphere verifies the geometry map only. Its coefficients and the full-domain existence witness are never supplied as optimizer initial guesses.
failure_policy: Keep all screening, rejected trials and restarts. Do not change the axis, densities, weights, seeds, discretization or budget to obtain success. Freeze the first informative failure for offline diagnosis.
